scope: Representative actual files or read-only numerical API responses for five resource records. This is not full validation of every database file. Bulk data remain outside the repository.

metadata.project_summary: We report bisulfite-induced deletion sequencing (BID-seq), which uses a bisulfite-mediated reaction to convert pseudouridine stoichiometrically into deletion upon reverse transcription without cytosine deamination. BID-seq enables detection of pseudouridine sites with stoichiometry information in several human cell lines (polyA+ RNA from wild-type HeLa, HEK293T and A549 cells) and 12 different mouse tissues (polyA+ RNA from 12 mouse tissues).
metadata.project_title: Quantitative sequencing using BID-seq uncovers abundant pseudouridines in mammalian mRNA at base resolution

resources.label_type: Measured-assay-derived endogenous modification frequency/coverage; annotations and metadata separate
resources.integration_decision: Can annotate endogenous sequence/site context or support modification-assay analyses. Not a direct label or measured modification state for delivered synthetic RNA.
limits: One HEK293T BID-seq pseudouridine dataset audited; no database-wide numerical validation
Dataset title says three replicates, but exported file has one record per site without replicate columns
Current docs describe newer /datasets routes that return404 on this deployed site; legacy routes discovered from its own public application work
Cross-study cell identity does not establish matching culture, dose, time or intracellular RNA modification state

resources.label_type: Assay-supported endogenous site/condition calls; quantification file contains study-condition measurements with missing values, not a universal modified-fraction assay
resources.integration_decision: Useful endogenous annotation and exploratory context evidence after genome/condition reconciliation; cannot mark the corresponding position as modified in an engineered reporter.
limits: 843678 support rows refer to427760 unique sites; do not treat support rows as independent modified positions
High-resolution support and bulk quantification have different assay interpretations
Quantification file read as bounded compressed prefix only; no full-file count or checksum claimed
No full measured synthetic-RNA modification-to-protein output matrix
Reported logFC values must not be interpreted as calibrated occupancy fractions

resources.label_type: Read-count-derived tRNA abundance fields and positional coverage/mismatch/stop arrays; not calibrated charging or universal modification fractions
resources.integration_decision: Exploratory functional tRNA context only after selecting comparable assays and treatments. Inspected numerical condition is perturbed and cannot be assigned to untreated HepG2 reporter output.
limits: 650 tRNA entities but only81 with nonzero counts/coverage in inspected response
total field is zero in every inspected entity despite positive counts in81; interpretation remains unresolved
No per-replicate entity dimension; metadata can aggregate multiple GSMs
Cell labels alone do not establish preparation or biological-condition equivalence
One numerical condition verified, not all528 datasets

resources.label_type: The index is reference metadata; downstream dedicated assays provide counts/derived charging fractions
resources.integration_decision: Useful study discovery. Downloaded charging studies support their own stress/cell-state analyses; neither is a matched cell-context covariate matrix for the circRNA reporter panels.
limits: GSE239867 covers mouse MEFs and human NTERT keratinocytes under stress; unlabeled colon-separated count columns require mapping before calculation
GSE188855 has12 samples and67 tRNA IDs per file, with Ratio equal to100*CCA/(CCA+CC) within rounding
GSE188855 sample GSM5691036 title is Lung_starvation_rep1 but treatment metadata says untreated; preserve the conflict and resolve against study design before assigning labels
The GSE188855 study is a separately investigated charging experiment; current T-psi-C index explicitly links GSE239867
No circRNA/mRNA protein-output labels in these tRNA processed files

resources.label_type: Curated reference modification positions, not numerical cell-state abundance/activity
resources.integration_decision: Use as chemical/reference vocabulary and site annotation only; cannot join by cell to predict output.
limits: Audited three legacy .mods files within one download archive, not every current MODOMICS endpoint
No cell-line or protein-output fields in inspected tables
Reference positions do not imply modification stoichiometry or actual presence in a new synthetic RNA

scientific_conclusion: None of these five supplies matched synthetic mRNA/circRNA sequence-by-cell protein-output labels. They can provide references or hypothesis-driven auxiliary features, but joining by cell name alone would introduce unmeasured-context assumptions. Direct translation-specific claims need separately defined RNA persistence/exposure and protein kinetics measurements.
